title: Mitigating Gender Bias in Distilled Language Models via Counterfactual Role Reversal

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluation of open-ended text generation using BOLD profession prompts to measure gender polarity and equitability ratios. Also evaluated using Contextual Embedding Association Tests (CEAT) for embedding bias, and True Positive Rate Difference (TPRD) in the Bios-Bias downstream classification task.

Evaluation of open-ended text generation using BOLD race prompts and a regard classifier to measure the ratio and variance of positive, negative, and neutral regard across African American, Asian American, European American, and Hispanic/Latino groups.
